Sekhiya 6 of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga, titled *Dutiyasusaṁvuta* ("Being unrestrained"), constitutes the sixth training rule of the *sekhiya* class in the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka. The text sets forth behavioral etiquette for Buddhist monastics, forming part of the standard disciplinary code recorded in the Vibhaṅga. Modern translations include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
